nodes.label: Single-Label Wildcard TLS Certificate Constraint
nodes.rationale: One wildcard certificate (*.qrserve.safaricom.et) covers every tenant but is single-label only - it does NOT cover a.b.qrserve.safaricom.et - which is why branches are path segments rather than second-level subdomains. upstream-vhost is pinned to $host explicitly so tenant resolution via the Host header cannot be silently broken by a future edit, and proxy-read-timeout is raised to 600s so the STOMP WebSocket on /ws/** is not cut for an idle kitchen display.
